kurals.tr: Kaamam Uzhandhu Varundhinaarkku Emam / Matalalladhu Illai Vali
kurals.m: To those who after enjoyment of sexual pleasure suffer (for want of more), there is no help so efficient as the palmyra horse

kurals.tr: Nonaa Utampum Uyirum Matalerum / Naaninai Neekki Niruththu
kurals.m: Having got rid of shame, the suffering body and soul save themselves on the palmyra horse

kurals.tr: Naanotu Nallaanmai Pantutaiyen Indrutaiyen / Kaamutraar Erum Matal
kurals.m: Modesty and manliness were once my own; now, my own is the palmyra horse that is ridden by the lustful

kurals.tr: Kaamak Katumpunal Uykkum Naanotu / Nallaanmai Ennum Punai
kurals.m: The raft of modesty and manliness, is, alas, carried-off by the strong current of lust

kurals.tr: Thotalaik Kurundhoti Thandhaal Matalotu / Maalai Uzhakkum Thuyar
kurals.m: She with the small garland-like bracelets has given me the palmyra horse and the sorrow that is endured at night

kurals.tr: Mataloordhal Yaamaththum Ulluven Mandra / Patalollaa Pedhaikken Kan
kurals.m: Mine eyes will not close in sleep on your mistress's account; even at midnight will I think of mounting the palmyra horse

kurals.tr: Katalanna Kaamam Uzhandhum Mataleraap / Pennin Perundhakka Thil
kurals.m: There is nothing so noble as the womanly nature that would not ride the palmyra horse, though plunged a sea of lust

kurals.tr: Niraiyariyar Manaliyar Ennaadhu Kaamam / Maraiyirandhu Mandru Patum
kurals.m: Even the Lust (of women) transgresses its secrecy and appears in public, forgetting that they are too chaste and liberal (to be overcome by it)

kurals.tr: Arikilaar Ellaarum Endreen Kaamam / Marukin Marukum Maruntu
kurals.m: And thus, in public ways, perturbed will rove

kurals.tr: Yaamkannin Kaana Nakupa Arivillaar / Yaampatta Thaampataa Aaru
kurals.m: Even strangers laugh (at us) so as to be seen by us, for they have not suffered
